title: Supply-Coverage Ceiling on Tailwise Pharmacy Pharmacy-Placed Renewals
content:
*Pharmacist medication-adherence review.*

The days' supply per fill of a renewal Tailwise Pharmacy places by itself is no more than the supply-coverage ceiling.

**Coverage percentage.** The days' supply dispensed on the renewed prescription, net of the days' supply of the fills credited back to it, as a percentage of the calendar days from its authorization date to the renewal date.

## Ceiling

| Coverage percentage | Supply-coverage ceiling |
|---|---|
| 85 percent or more | the class's maximum days' supply per fill |
| at least 70 percent but below 85 percent | the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill plus 15 days, never more than the class maximum |
| below 70 percent | the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill |

## Worked cases (hypothetical; prescription written for 30 days, class maximum 90 days)

- Authorized 2026-01-01, renewal dated 2026-07-20: 200 days. Dispensed days' supply 180, none credited back: 90 percent, ceiling 90 days.
- Same dates, 150 days' supply net of a 30-day fill credited back: 75 percent, ceiling 30 plus 15, 45 days.
- Same dates, 120 days' supply: 60 percent, ceiling 30 days.

Boundary: exactly 85 percent reaches the top row; exactly 70 percent the middle row.
